visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a mouth-watering close-up of a golden-brown fried chicken wing topped with a cluster of bright yellow corn kernels, held by dark chopsticks against a blurred kitchen background. (2) The scene shifts to a glass bowl where a person's hands add white salt to clear water and stir with chopsticks; then, four raw chicken wings are submerged in the brine, and a silver fork is used to repeatedly prick the skin. (3) The wings are transferred to another glass bowl where white cornstarch is sprinkled over them, and the bowl is shaken vigorously to ensure an even, powdery coating on each piece. (4) In a black skillet, the coated wings are carefully placed into shallow, shimmering oil and fried until the skin turns a crispy, deep golden-brown texture. (5) A whole cooked corn cob is sliced vertically on a wooden board to remove the kernels, which are then tossed in the glass bowl with remaining flour and spices before being fried in the pan until lightly charred. (6) Chopped green spring onions and sliced red chilies are added to the pan with the corn, followed by the fried wings, and then fine red chili powder, cumin powder, and black pepper are sprinkled over the mixture while it is tossed. (7) The final dish is plated, showing the crispy wings buried under a pile of seasoned corn and aromatics, presented under bright, warm studio lighting.

(3) A distinct mechanical rhythmic thudding occurs as the fork pricks the chicken skin, accompanied by continuous enthusiastic narration. (4) The BGM continues as a loud, crisp sizzling sound dominates the mix when the chicken wings are placed in the hot oil. (5) A sharp, percussive chopping sound is heard when the corn cob is sliced on the wooden board. (6) The sizzle intensifies as corn and chicken are tossed together, with audible metallic scrapes from the spoon against the pan. (7) High-frequency 'whoosh' sound effects are used during rapid visual transitions, ending with a final enthusiastic call to action from the speaker as the music swells.
